subject: maths
question: A man invested ₹4,500 at 5% per annum and ₹5,500 at 8% per annum simple interest. Both investments were for 4 years each. The amount received from the lower rate of interest is what per cent (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the amount received from the higher rate of interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest % for 4 years: **Lower rate** = 5% × 4 = 20% | **Higher rate** = 8% × 4 = 32%.

Amount 1 (Lower) = 4500 × 120% = 5400.

Amount 2 (Higher) = 5500 × 132% = 7260.

Required % = (5400 ÷ 7260) × 100 ≈ 74%.

**∴ The correct answer is 74%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **Principal (P₁)** = ₹4,500, **Rate (R₁)** = 5%, **Time (T)** = 4 years.

Case 2: **Principal (P₂)** = ₹5,500, **Rate (R₂)** = 8%, **Time (T)** = 4 years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/014eb89a152d14c5db95494ee58c0713a939a82738e4545deeebd6c6269dbb30.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI₁ = (4500 × 5 × 4) ÷ 100 = 900

⇒ Amount₁ (lower rate) = 4500 + 900 = ₹5,400

⇒ SI₂ = (5500 × 8 × 4) ÷ 100 = 1760

⇒ Amount₂ (higher rate) = 5500 + 1760 = ₹7,260

⇒ Required Percentage = (5400 ÷ 7260) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 54000 ÷ 726 ≈ 74.38%

⇒ Rounded off to the nearest integer = 74%

**∴ The correct answer is 74%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Concept

Interest is calculated only on the initial **Principal** amount for every year. SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total **Amount** (A) received at the end of the period is the sum of Principal and Interest: A = P(1 + RT/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

The total interest earned can be expressed as a single **effective percentage** of the principal, which is (Rate × Time)%.
